name: histopathologic-cancer-detection
description: Write a Python fit_predict(train, test_inputs, time_budget_s) function that learns from 45,819 labelled 48 x 48 PatchCamelyon lymph-node patch crops and returns a tumour probability in [0, 1] for each of 11,672 test crops from held-out whole-slide images, within a 600 s wall-clock budget on 4 CPU threads; scored by ROC AUC (higher is better).

sources.locator: PatchCamelyon valid and test files: images, labels and slide metadata (data CC0 per github.com/basveeling/pcam; MIT per the Zenodo record)
README: labels refer to the central 32 x 32 pixel region; splits are slide-disjoint; data licence
grade.py (ROC AUC; utils.prepare_for_auroc_metric requires probabilities in [0, 1])
competition definition: PCam without duplicate patches

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.
